description: Retrieves details about the Trello member who created the action with the given `idAction`.

fields.description: A comma-separated list of member fields to retrieve, or 'all'. Valid fields include: avatarHash, avatarSource, bio, bioData, confirmed, email, fullName, gravatarHash, idBoards, idBoardsPinned, idOrganizations, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, loginTypes, memberType, oneTimeMessagesDismissed, prefs, premiumFeatures, products, status, trophies, uploadedAvatarHash, url, username.
fields.title: Fields

idAction.description: The ID of the Trello action.
idAction.title: Id Action

name: get_actions_member_creator_by_id_action

activityBlocked.description: Indicates whether the member's activity is blocked
activityBlocked.title: Activity Blocked

avatarHash.description: Hash string used to construct the avatar URL
avatarHash.title: Avatar Hash

avatarSource.description: Source of the avatar (e.g., upload, gravatar)
avatarSource.title: Avatar Source

avatarUrl.description: Full URL to the member's avatar image. Returns null if avatar privacy is not set to public
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

bioData.description: Structured data containing emoji and other bio-related information
bioData.title: Bio Data

confirmed.description: Whether the member's account has been confirmed
confirmed.title: Confirmed

fullName.description: Member's full name. Returns the same as username if fullName privacy is not set to public
fullName.title: Full Name

idBoards.description: Array of board IDs the member belongs to
idBoards.title: Id Boards

idBoardsPinned.description: Array of board IDs the member has pinned
idBoardsPinned.title: Id Boards Pinned

idEnterprise.description: Identifier of the enterprise the member belongs to
idEnterprise.title: Id Enterprise

idEnterprisesDeactivated.description: Array of enterprise IDs where the member has been deactivated
idEnterprisesDeactivated.title: Id Enterprises Deactivated

idMemberReferrer.description: ID of the member who referred this member
idMemberReferrer.title: Id Member Referrer

idOrganizations.description: Array of organization IDs the member belongs to
idOrganizations.title: Id Organizations

idPremOrgsAdmin.description: Array of premium organization IDs where the member is an admin
idPremOrgsAdmin.title: Id Prem Orgs Admin

initials.description: Member's initials, typically derived from their name
initials.title: Initials

loginTypes.description: Array of login methods available for the member
loginTypes.title: Login Types

nonPublic.description: Object containing private member information not visible to other users
nonPublic.title: Non Public

oneTimeMessagesDismissed.description: Array of one-time message IDs that have been dismissed by the member
oneTimeMessagesDismissed.title: One Time Messages Dismissed

premiumFeatures.description: Array of premium features available to the member
premiumFeatures.title: Premium Features

products.description: Array of Trello products the member has access to
products.title: Products

status.description: Current status of the member account
status.title: Status

trophies.description: Array of trophies or achievements earned by the member
trophies.title: Trophies

uploadedAvatarHash.description: Hash of the uploaded avatar image
uploadedAvatarHash.title: Uploaded Avatar Hash

url.description: URL to the member's Trello profile
url.title: Url
